title: fix: preserve all relational columns
body:
## Summary

I noticed relationship discovery stops after the first linked-record field found on each Airtable record.

That means a record with both `Founders` and `Sectors`, for example, can expose only one relationship to the graph. Which relationship survives can also depend on field order.

This removes the early `break` so every relational field encountered on a record is retained.

## Validation

Added seven small regression tests covering:

- multiple relationship fields on one record
- reversed field order
- relationships discovered across different records
- empty and ordinary list fields
- tables without relationships
- the existing single-relationship case
- propagation of both relationships into graph edges

In the isolated reproduction, the original implementation fails 4/7 cases; with the one-line production change all 7 pass.

The tests exercise the two relevant functions with synthetic Airtable-shaped records and a mocked `Network`. I haven't claimed live Airtable or browser validation.

Thanks for open-sourcing this! I was looking through some of your graph projects and thought this was a nice small invariant to tighten up before exploring anything larger.
